title: Debiased parametric inference for regime-switching jump diffusions with infinite variation jumps
summary: We study high-frequency inference for an ergodic regime-switching jump diffusion with locally stable infinite-variation jumps. The state and the finite-state regime are observed on the same grid. The mesh satisfies \(h_n\to0\), while the horizon satisfies \(T_n=nh_n\to\infty\). We estimate structural drift and diffusion parameters in the presence of unknown regime-specific Lévy measures. For a common activity index \(1<β<8/5\), we remove two leading jump biases from each regime's truncated variation.
